title: 0033-skillsight-efficient-firstperson-skill-assessment-with
universal_lens: The SkillSight primitive formalizes a multimodal operator mapping spatiotemporal visual tensors and 3D gaze trajectories into a latent proficiency manifold. It employs a teacher-student distillation kernel, projecting high-dimensional egocentric video onto a low-power, gaze-only subspace while preserving the topological structure of skill-level embeddings.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps the SkillSight MLP fusion to a Bayesian hierarchical classifier. The gaze dynamics serve as informative priors over action sequences, updating posterior skill distributions via conformal inference. This allows quantifying epistemic uncertainty in athlete proficiency when only sparse attentional telemetry is available.
gse_mapping: In GSE, the gaze-induced attention map acts as a dynamic state-transition filter. By isolating attended-object sequences, the engine computes situational awareness vectors. The distillation token aligns real-time cognitive load states with historical performance baselines, enabling predictive modeling of decision-making bottlenecks.

reasoning_traces.think:
The SkillSight framework introduces a sophisticated dual-stage operator designed to decouple high-fidelity perception from efficient inference. Mathematically, it defines a joint manifold M = V x G, where V represents the egocentric video stream and G denotes the 3D gaze trajectory. The teacher network, SkillSight-T, learns a complex mapping F: M -> S (skill space) by integrating three distinct kernels: an attention-modulated visual encoder, a localized object-sequence extractor, and a global gaze-dynamics transformer. These embeddings are concatenated and projected via a multi-layer perceptron to yield the skill estimate. Crucially, the system employs knowledge distillation to compress this high-dimensional mapping into a gaze-only student model, SkillSight-S. This student minimizes the Kullback-Leibler divergence between its output distribution and the teacher's soft labels, effectively transferring the structural priors of video-based assessment into the lower-dimensional gaze subspace. However, the mathematical elegance collapses when applied to third-person broadcast data. The isomorphism relies entirely on the existence of synchronized first-person optical flow and precise oculomotor telemetry. In the absence of these variables—such as in standard NFL All-22 footage—the operator loses its foundational inputs, rendering the gaze-induced attention map undefined and the distillation target inaccessible.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This primitive traces its lineage to early psychophysics models linking saccadic patterns to cognitive load, later formalized in computational neuroscience through predictive coding frameworks. The use of teacher-student distillation echoes advancements in compressed sensing and neural architecture search, aiming to preserve information-theoretic capacity while reducing computational entropy. Historically, it bridges the gap between raw sensory data and abstract skill evaluation, evolving from simple heuristic gaze metrics to deep multimodal embeddings.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: From a theory-of-mind perspective, the model implicitly constructs a representation of the agent's internal attentional state. By treating gaze not merely as a physical coordinate but as a proxy for intentionality, the system infers the performer's strategic priorities. The teacher network acts as an omniscient observer, correlating external actions with internal focus, while the student learns to mimic this inferential process using only the 'window to the soul'—the eyes—thereby modeling the hidden cognitive variables driving athletic execution.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A strict cross-layer veto is triggered due to fundamental data modality mismatch. GSE operates exclusively on third-person broadcast and tracking coordinates; it lacks the egocentric video streams and millisecond-precision eye-tracking required by the SkillSight operator. Attempting to force an isomorphism would introduce severe leakage, as the 'gaze' variable becomes purely hallucinatory. Furthermore, the coarse, subjective nature of the source skill labels (novice vs. expert) fails to meet the granular, continuous performance metrics demanded by professional sports intelligence, invalidating any direct transfer of the learned manifolds.
